content.summary: All six source changes preserve mathematical content, and the inspected PDF mapping expressions preserve signs, powers and equivalence scope. Frozen hashes and the F34 manifest/file digests checked successfully. This is a source-to-display semantic audit, not a visual layout certification.

checks.scope: Six formula replacements and PDF mappings
checks.method: Matched all six manuscript displays exactly to F34 source-change and mapping records; inspected renderer markup and reversed the changes to compare the earlier manuscript digest.
checks.observation: Each edit only replaces terminal punctuation with a text-mode period. Reversal reproduces the prior a5097eb4 manuscript digest. The mappings retain squared degrees, three positive pair falling-factorials and negative t(t-1); the pointwise correction retains binom(j,2)-binom(j,3). The equivalence remains I(27) iff absence of an intersecting 28-member rank-four sunflower-free family on Fin 72. Its capacity is correctly intermediate; Theorem 5 still separately supplies Fin 53/56, with the Type versus Type-u qualification unchanged.
